reserveReview.rationale: Write-time re-open 2026-07-30. Issuer docs and UsdtDepositManager source confirm dual routes: users lock USDT on Optimism or USDC on Base; DepositManager supplies the deposit token into Aave V3 and mints JPYT. Live aToken balances of the DepositManager proxies measure the reserve envelope: Optimism aOptUSDT (0x6ab707aca953edaefbc4fd23ba73294241490620) balanceOf(0x77c1e40f5e7bb19c34d81f986fb13fe655f23cd9) = 44,797.16 USDT at block 154923376; Base aBasUSDC (0x4e65fe4dba92790696d040ac24aa414708f5c0ab) balanceOf(0x0eab9d66adb8527cd7c0e7e7c1782580431ec276) = 6,893.12 USDC at block 49328091; combined 51,690.27 USD -> 86.66%/13.34% rounded to 87/13 integer slices. Matching totalDepositToken reads (40,544.29 USDT / 6,059.53 USDC) confirm the same ~87/13 liability split. Operator-claimable Aave surplus (getCurrentAaveProfit) is included in aToken balances and is not a separate reserve class. Residual unknowns: Aave utilization-driven withdrawal latency and legal custody terms beyond on-chain smart-contract custody.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: On-chain aToken balances of DePhaser DepositManager proxies plus issuer money-flow docs
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Legal segregation/bankruptcy-remoteness of Aave positions and instantaneous redeemable liquidity under high Aave utilization are not published as static legal terms; weights themselves are measured.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Reserves are held as Aave aTokens by upgradeable DepositManager contracts; Aave markets rehypothecate supply to borrowers. No off-chain segregated custody, bankruptcy-remote trust, or legal segregation opinion was located. DepositManager DEFAULT_ADMIN can self-grant UPGRADER_ROLE and replace the implementation.
